newsitem.title: USA: GeoResources reports output at horizontal well.
newsitem.headline: GeoResources reports output at horizontal well.

text.p: GeoResources Inc said Monday initial daily production from its Oscar Fossum H3 horizontal well was 539 barrels of oil and 44 barrels of water for the morning of December 22.

The well was put into production December 19 and has been at maximum pump capacity of about 600 barrels of total fluid per day, a company spokesman said. The company owns a 67-percent stake in the well and serves as the operator.
GeoResources is a diversified natural resources exploration and produciton company.
Its stock closed up 3/8 Monday at 3-3/4.
